gold.text: Users can successfully enter ingredients, including name, quantity, and optional shelf-life information, and can edit or delete these records.

pred.text: Pantry list shows each ingredient's name, quantity, and expiration date.

gold.text: The system can identify ingredients nearing their expiration date based on the entered expiration date and provide a clear visual prompt on the interface.

pred.text: Pantry items expiring within 3 days are highlighted with an "Expiring soon" badge.

gold.text: Users can set their dietary preferences (such as vegetarian, high-protein, or budget-friendly), which will be accurately applied when generating meal plans.

pred.text: Vegetarian preference limits the plan to vegetarian recipes.

gold.text: The system can automatically generate a multi-day (e.g., week-long) meal plan based on current ingredient inventory, expiration date priority, and user preferences.

pred.text: Ingredients closest to expiry are used in the earliest meals.

gold.text: The system can automatically calculate and generate a "missing ingredients" shopping list based on the generated meal plan, which does not include ingredients that are in stock.

pred.text: Grocery list shows missing and insufficient ingredients with the shortfall amount.

gold.text: After a user locks some of the meals, a new plan can be generated for the remaining unlocked portions. The new plan will be optimized based on the updated inventory (after deducting the ingredients for the locked meals).

pred.text: Locked meals and days are kept when the plan is regenerated.

gold.text: When regenerating the plan, the system will prioritize using remaining near-expiry ingredients and continue to adhere to the user's set dietary preferences.
Users can manually adjust ingredient quantities for existing recipes, and the planned ingredient consumption and shopping list will be updated in real time after the adjustment.

pred.text: Generated plan shows day-by-day meals, each with a named recipe.
Clicking a recipe expands its ingredient list inline.

gold.text: The shopping list can be displayed by category (such as vegetables, meat, and seasonings) or by store area, making it easier to make actual purchases.

pred.text: Pantry form rejects an empty name or a non-positive quantity.

gold.text: When a user manually modifies the inventory (such as consuming some ingredients), the system can provide options to reassess whether the current plan needs adjustment.
Users can lock specific meals or entire dates in their plans. Once locked, these portions are visually clearly marked and will not be affected by subsequent adjustments.

pred.text: Lock toggle changes its icon and label immediately.

gold.text: When food inventory is insufficient or there are no feasible solutions, the system will provide a clear prompt (such as "Unable to generate a dinner plan for Tuesday. Please check inventory or adjust preferences").

pred.text: Pantry items already past their expiration date are not used in the plan.

gold.text: The response time for all operations (such as adding ingredients, generating plans, and locking meals) should be within a reasonable range, without noticeable lag, and should provide corresponding loading or completion status feedback.
